name: Rome
about: Ancient sites are best explored in the mild shoulder seasons. Summer is scorching and swarmed with queues; many locals (and some restaurants) leave in August.
overview: Three thousand years of history stacked on top of itself, best explored on foot between plates of cacio e pepe.
costOverview: An Aperol spritz or a pizza slice on the go costs almost nothing; sit down for a real dinner and the math changes fast.
